query: How can educators improve learning satisfaction?

per_column.name: adaptive_content_delivery_strategy
per_column.rationale: A configurable pedagogical choice educators can set (async tools, video, segmented lessons) — an intervenable lever.

per_column.name: synchronous_interaction_design
per_column.rationale: How live sessions are structured is a settable design decision by educators.

per_column.name: peer_community_structure
per_column.rationale: Educators can decide to assign collaborative projects, peer review, etc. — intervenable.

per_column.name: hands_on_or_kinesthetic_access
per_column.rationale: Whether kits/simulations/demos are provided is a deliberate instructional choice — settable.

per_column.name: feedback_turnaround_and_personalization
per_column.rationale: Feedback speed and personalization is directly under educator control — an intervenable lever.

per_column.name: technical_platform_stability
per_column.rationale: Platform reliability affects both which delivery/interaction strategies are feasible and satisfaction; a common cause. Arguably partly settable but here framed as background condition.

per_column.name: student_engagement_and_motivation_baseline
per_column.rationale: Pre-existing engagement influences both the interventions educators apply/that students take up and their satisfaction — a classic unnamed confounder.

per_column.name: developmental_stage_fit
per_column.rationale: Corresponds to grade_level already in the table; a common cause of appropriate strategy and satisfaction but effectively named.

per_column.name: subject_discipline_and_remote_fit
per_column.rationale: Corresponds to subject already in the table; influences which strategies suit and satisfaction, but named/implied.

judge.rationale: The schema strongly realises the what-if claim. Multiple treatments are genuinely intervenable levers educators can set (delivery mode, synchronous design, peer structure, hands-on access, feedback). It also supplies confounders that are common causes of both treatment uptake and satisfaction: student_engagement_baseline and platform_stability are NOT named in the query and demonstrate the capability under test, while developmental_stage and subject fit map to existing table columns (named/implied). No columns are mistaken for mediators-as-confounders. This passes the interventional test.
